payload.body: Task 1 start. Approach: (1) M1/M2 tag grammar — strip a trailing [Mn, ...] citation tag off Proof Run: values in parse_task, record stripped commands in proof_runs and sorted clause ids in a parallel proof_run_cites; refuse unknown-clause tags beside clause_citation_violations using the same span text; a tag never counts as a citing leg. (2) M3-M6 green_at_base_lines(tasks, base_tree, timeout_s=GREEN_AT_BASE_TIMEOUT_S=30): detached worktree under tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='ultra-green-'), bash -lc with ULTRA_BASE, start_new_session + killpg on TimeoutExpired, finally worktree remove --force + prune + rmtree; one fact line per exit-0 command (prover vs guard wording), timeout line, and a final reading line. (3) M7 wiring in the --check branch of main between STALE advisories and the AUTHORING fact line, only when rc==0 and --base given.

- (b) [M2] renderLaunch of a baseFacts of ['BASE fact: x','GREEN-AT-BASE fact: y','AUTHORING fact: none recorded'] carries the GREEN-AT-BASE fact: y line exactly once; a result with no baseFacts carries no GREEN-AT-BASE fact: at all. - (c) [M3] the '## Per run' to '## States' window of fleet/RUNBOOK.md, joined on spaces the way tr '\n' ' ' joins it, matches the third Run: line's BASE fact:.*STALE fact:.*GREEN-AT-BASE fact:.*AUTHORING fact:.*launch line and the fourth's GREEN-AT-BASE fact:.*fact.*not a refusal — the same two greps, read in process, which is this file's established way with a documentation Run: line (its (d) legs).
